## Status, scientific honesty, and remaining release gates
**Status: Scientifically corrected working design, not a released/validated thesis results deck.** Open issues include case-specific equipment model qualification, original synchronized EVSE AC input/temperature data, independent T_e→P and P→T_e causal evidence, complete verification and validation, measured required-service trajectories, bounded sustainability indicators and SDG compatibility.

The remaining AI-generated concept images on Slides 1 and 3 are still raster and have natural illustrative equipment colors. They must not be cited as real field photos. All remaining diagrams are native/editable, improving sharpness at zoom/projection. A structural Google Slides audit (slide IDs/master/sidebar/component counts) was run. An independent rendered pixel-level visual/overlap/caption-safe accessibility review remains **OPEN**; do not claim that all text fits perfectly at every projector scaling until inspected in the Google Slides UI.
